name: What is the difference between baseboards, casing, and crown molding?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between baseboards, casing, and crown molding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baseboards protect drywall from vacuum strikes and foot traffic, casings frame and seal doors and windows, and crown molding bridges wall-to-ceiling transitions. Baseboards run along the floor and take the most daily wear and tear. Door and window casings hide the rough framing gaps and ensure draft-free transitions. Crown molding is purely decorative, adding depth, architectural character, and visual height to a room. Understanding which elements need attention clarifies whether your project requires basic protective boards or intricate ceiling-level joinery.
acceptedAnswer.description: Baseboards protect the base of walls, casings conceal framing around doors and windows, and crown molding decorates the upper joint between walls and ceilings.
